Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-1.1; milestone-film.
Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md. Mote remains authoritative; one primary agent and at most one helper.

Reconciliation: Acceptance retained; this audit did not run its proposed tests.

Remaining / next action: Execute the terminal public recall-map route over a compiled film source using the same P/F/remainder/twin courts. Keep actual Atlas/browser and licensed-input qualification separate; do not restore its removed Baseball prerequisite.

Release tags schedule work; they do not establish completion or empirical qualification. Use current AGENTS.md for ownership, scoped gates and exact-SHA review; old fleet roles, timers and fixed gate task counts are historical. Keep the original scientific preregistration, denominators, admission and sealed-test rules below.

Retained acceptance and design context:

Scheduling lane: later. Current plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md. Live dependency edges supersede historical sequencing below.

Current disposition, 2026-09-19; governing docs/refactor/PLAN.md.
Ruling E: 1.x full film-model wire/terminal capability; separate from the initial mapping exchange preview.

Original scope retained below for evidence; fleet procedure/assignments are historical and do not govern single-developer work.

CODE RED E0 TERMINAL VERTICAL. This bead is the product proof. It begins only after P1R, B0R, D0, D1A, D1B and V1 are complete.

Exact paths:
- fixtures/.jvm/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/fixtures/sherlock/SherlockVertical.scala
- fixtures/.jvm/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/fixtures/sherlock/SherlockVerticalSuite.scala
- fixtures/.jvm/src/test/resources/storymodel4s/fixtures/sherlock/synthetic-pair.json
- tools/run-sherlock-vertical.sh
- tools/run-sherlock-vertical-test.sh
- docs/data/sherlock/e0-replay-receipt.json
- docs/data/sherlock/e0-result.json
- docs/data/sherlock/e0-report.html

The command accepts explicit local paths for the two Sherlock video parts and admitted non-video artifacts plus an output directory. It may stream the local movie bytes only to verify the pinned hashes and stream identities; it never copies, embeds, stores, uploads or redistributes video bytes. Every non-video input and output follows its B0R admission.

Required command result: exact edition and presentation clock; checked Sherlock NarrativeSourceAtlas and diagnostic source graph; checked RecallGraph; complete nomination bundle; GraphHsmm P and F, named external states and Viterbi summary; exact source movie intervals for every source alternative; RecallSignature and trace; versioned machine-readable bundle; static locally openable report where keyboard focus on one recall unit reveals its words, posterior alternatives and exact mass, faithful or distorted or external mode, incoming and outgoing F, hierarchy, evidence, missing or imputed or unavailable states and provenance, with a deterministic textual twin.

Terminal courts: same inputs run twice byte-identically; output contains no movie bytes; every posterior row and flow marginal is checked and displayed mass plus retained remainder is complete; exact interval links resolve to the pinned edition. Mutations for foreign video part, swapped part order, timebase reset, alias shift, omitted source, split or merge, compression, reorder, backward revisit, long jump, external excursion, facet distortion, missing support, non-finite value, foreign provider/candidate/cost/output receipt and dropped P or F each fail or change only the declared observable. SemanticsUnestablished produces source-only output with zero semantic marks. No default is called calibrated; external-floor claims wait for the separate frozen calibration protocol.

Gate: browser automation guard audit before and after any visual QA; product-controlled browser only; exact reference-scope JVM gate; fixturesJVM tests; shell court, bash-n and ShellCheck; compileAll and scalafmtCheckAll; independent numerical oracle, accessibility DOM assertions, screenshot density review and a second scientific reviewer. Completion requires the actual admitted Sherlock pair, not only the synthetic fixture.
